paragraphs: R' Tzadok, Rabbi's pupil, one of the earliest amoraim; end of Ein Doreshin. He and R' Simai went to intercalate years in Lod, and ruled concerning a womb as Rabbi did concerning a crop: Hullin 56b. Nahalat Shimoni erred and thought this was the earlier R' Tzadok.
